title: Open Data and the Status Quo - A Fine-Grained Evaluation Framework for Open Data Quality and an Analysis of Open Data portals in Germany
reasoning: The paper presents a technical framework for evaluating the quality of open data portals. It analyzes dimensions like interoperability, findability, completeness, and legal openness. The content does not touch upon topics of religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a subject of evaluation or benchmarking.
